# TripSync

> TripSync is a private group photo-sharing service that uses AI face recognition to deliver event and group photos. Everyone gets only the photos they appear in, at full resolution — delivered from one shared link.

## Who uses TripSync
- Wedding, event, and portrait photographers who need to deliver a whole shoot to a couple and all their guests from a single link.
- Event hosts and organisers — parties, corporate events, conferences, sports days — sharing photos with everyone who attended.
- Friends and families sharing trip and get-together photos.

## How it works
1. A photographer or host creates an event group and uploads the photos. Large uploads are done from the web portal, TripSync Studio.
2. They share one invite link.
3. Each guest opens the link and adds a quick selfie. TripSync's face recognition finds every photo that guest appears in and delivers them at full resolution — no manual sorting, no separate gallery per person.
4. Photographers can watermark previews for proofing and grant full-quality access once a client has paid.

## Why photographers choose TripSync
- One link for the whole event instead of per-guest galleries.
- AI face recognition so each guest instantly sees only their own photos.
- Full-resolution delivery (not compressed chat forwards).
- Private, invite-only groups.
- Watermark/proofing to sell event photos.
